summary: Frontend-only FASE B verification of MikiLab 'Il Tuo Laboratorio' (mobile 390x844 + desktop 1920). Unlocked via the non-registered 7-day local trial. Verified: (1) new 6th step 'Conclusione Lavorazione' with maestro-conclusione banner (3 checklist items) + closing tools sessioni/lotti/haccp + 'Passo 6/6' + maestro-done 'Completo' (maestro-next absent on last step); (2) Capo Laboratorio has NO capo-use-weekly checkbox (0 checkboxes on page) while capo-products and machine/cell config render; (3) Mohammadreza rename: avatar loads (1024x1024, /mohammed-avatar.jpg), role label 'Mohammadreza Jafari · Assistente di Michele (MikiLab)', heading 'Ciao, sono Mohammadreza', Michele-creator copy, toggle 'Chiedi a Mohammadreza', no 'Mohammed' string left in the card; chat streamed a full coherent Italian reply; (4) Regressions OK: local-trial-start -> local-trial-banner 'Prova gratuita — restano 7 giorni', steps 1-5 tool grids render (5/3/4/6/8 tools) with conclusione banner only on step 6, maestro-back-btn and browser back both close an opened tool, maestro-prev/maestro-next clickable with normal (non-forced) clicks and hit-tests resolve to themselves. No console/page errors. All FASE B acceptance criteria PASS.

issues: Floating 'Radio' (bottom-left) and 'Parla' (bottom-right) FABs overlay page content: on the Capo Laboratorio form they partially cover the 'ORA DI INIZIO' time input and the 'TEMP LAB OGGI' field (text '00 AM' visually clipped); on the stepper they visually sit over the footer/Michele card. Hit-test shows nav buttons still clickable, so cosmetic only, but add bottom padding / raise z-index ordering so FABs never sit over inputs.
3 closing tools in a 2-column grid leave an empty cell next to 'Registro HACCP' (cosmetic; consider col-span for the 3rd card or a 3-col layout on desktop).
Content column stays mobile-width and the decorative bakery photo on the bottom-right is cropped/floating oddly behind the 'Parla' FAB.
